### 🧬 [Biological Traits & Anatomy]
1. [Physiological Fact: Hairlessness]
Naturally Hairless: All females in this world are genetically and biologically born without pubic hair.
Universal Anatomy: Pubic hair does not exist in the human anatomy of this world. The skin is always naturally smooth.
Cultural Perception: Because pubic hair is non-existent, its absence is the absolute norm and is never commented upon or considered unusual.

* Potency: A single ejaculation from a healthy male restores Mana 10x faster than natural meditation. For a "High-Vitality" male like Kael (Player), the potency is equivalent to a legendary Elixir.

### 🗺️ [Heartland Geo-Matrix & Political Map]

[The Core: Veridia Barony — Player Domain]
* Location: A desolate buffer zone on the southern edge of the realm.
* Origin: Granted by Queen Alaric to a war veteran, to sit between the
  established houses and check their reach. Nobody was meant to prosper here.
* Note: How each neighbour regards Veridia, and how far word has travelled,
  is tracked by the system and shown each turn. Never state it from this entry.

---

### 1️⃣ North — The Iron Shield (Military Frontier)
* Region: The Grey Marches, held by Countess Morwen (모르웬 백작).
* Travel: 5 days by mountain road.
* What she counts: The Marches measure a domain by what it kills.
  Ground cleared of monsters is the one report a border patrol passes upward.

### 2️⃣ East — The Broken Coast (Trade Route)
* Region: The Azure Coast, held by Countess Liana (리아나 백작).
* Travel: 4 days downriver / 7 days by road.
* What she counts: River traffic stops where there is a dock.
  Veridia's bank has none, so the barges pass without a second look.

### 3️⃣ South — The Old Empire (Civilised Hub)
* Region: Valerius Domain, held by Countess Valerius (발레리우스 백작).
* Travel: 3 days on paved imperial road — the cheapest place to send anyone,
  and the first to notice if this land begins producing anything.
* What she counts: Yield and order. Her administration calls this land
  "the empty dirt between us and the North."

### 4️⃣ West — The High Plains (Magic Zone)
* Region: Silvana Highlands, held by Marquise Silvana (실바나 후작).
* Travel: 6 days, and the only road runs through the Whispering Woods.
* What she counts: Magic and rarity. Ordinary goods do not interest her;
  what comes out of that forest might.

### 5️⃣ Centre, Far North — The Royal Capital
* Region: Seat of Queen Alaric.
* Travel: 14 days by main road.
* Channels: Tribute is owed to the Royal Tax Office; maids are dispatched
  through the Royal Maid Academy. No other office in the Capital has a
  formal tie to Veridia. Tribute paid on time is the one message that
  reaches the throne without an envoy.

### 🐰  [Royal Maid Corps & System]
[The Academy: Professional Foundation]

Official Institution: Royal Academies for Domestic & Martial Service.
Requirement: State certification is mandatory. Uncertified = Common house servant (low status).
Curriculum: * Domestic: Accounting, Estate Management, Cooking, Sewing.
Martial: CQB (Unarmed/Blades), Poison ID, Basic Alchemy, Trap Disarming.
Social: Noble Etiquette, Heraldry, Intel Gathering, Discretion.

[The Maiden's Draft: Placement]
Tier 1 (Noble Patronage): High-score graduates. Nobles pay "Sponsorship Fee" to state. Private contracts. Elite status.
Tier 2 (Royal Assignment): State-run pool. Assigned to government posts or Low-born/Reclamation Nobles (User) as part of the "Reclamation Package."
[Rank Indicator: The "Ears"]

Junior Maid: Entry-level. Wear simple, stiffened cloth ribbons tied to look like upright ears. Basic and functional.

Intermediate Maid: Experienced backbone. Wear higher-quality satin or silk-textured ears. Signifies reliability.

Senior Maid: Veteran professionals. Wear elegant ears with distinctive lace trim or subtle embroidery. High-level domestic/martial skill.

Elite Maid: The pinnacle of the Corps. Wear ornate, heavily customized "Elite" ears often incorporating rare fabrics, silver threading, or unique structural designs. Signifies top-tier combat prowess and prestige.

[Tactical Role: The Symbiotic Unit]
More than Servants: Elite Bodyguard + Personal Attendant + Loyal Soldier.
Combat Doctrine: * Noblewoman (The Artillery): High-power spellcasting (requires concentration).
Maid (The Infantry): Close-quarters specialist. Intercepts attackers, creates space for casting.
Last Line of Defense: Experts in detecting poisons and ambushes within the inner sanctum.

[Social Significance]
Mobility: Primary path for commoner women with low magic to gain influence and prestige.
Influence: A personal maid to a high-ranking Countess is a figure of fear and respect.

### ⚔️  [Combat Prowess of the Maid Corps]

[Combat Power Scale]

* Junior Maid: Equivalent to a B-Rank Adventurer or 5-10 seasoned regular soldiers. Even the lowest graduate is a "Killing Machine" compared to commoners.
* Intermediate Maid: Equivalent to an A-Rank Adventurer or a Knight-Captain. Capable of suppressing a small-scale monster outbreak solo.
* Senior Maid: Equivalent to an S-Rank Adventurer. A tactical asset capable of turning the tide of a local skirmish.
* Elite Maid: "Nation-Level Threat." Their combat prowess is legendary, comparable to a high-ranking Hero or a Mythical Beast hunter.

[Operational Doctrine: Professionalism]

* Absolute Composure: Through "Psychological Conditioning" at the Academy, Maids are immune to panic. In the face of a monster, they prioritize threat assessment over fear.
* Zero-Hesitation Defense: Their first instinct is the "Master's Safety." They will use their own bodies as shields without a second thought, relying on their magical skin-armor.

[Martial Specialties]

* Mana-Infused Reflexes: they are trained to 'burst' their mana into their muscles for superhuman speed and precision.
* Environment Mastery: Maids are trained to fight in restricted spaces (hallways, bedrooms) and use "Domestic Tools" (cooking wires, needles, serving plates) as lethal weapons if necessary.


###💰  [Commerce & Merchant Guilds]
Structure: Hierarchical system of markets and guilds within the Aethelian Kingdom.
Influence: Guild power scales directly with local population and settlement prosperity.
Relation to Lords: Guilds provide vital supply lines but demand stability and protection in return.

### 👥 [Personnel & Recruitment Logistics]

(System Note: What each rank currently costs to hire and to keep, and which ranks

#### 1. The Royal Maid Academy
* Every certified maid belongs to the Academy, not to a house. A lord does not
  meet one and offer her work; he files a formal request and pays the employment
  fee the Academy sets.
* The Academy weighs where it is sending her. A domain with no name, no walls and
  no granary is a posting its graduates can refuse — and a reputation the Academy
  is unwilling to spend a good name on. Reputation is what opens the higher ranks;
  gold only settles the price.
* The Corps maids are Tier 2 — the state-assigned pool, held for government posts
  and for reclamation lords. They carry no private noble contract, which is the
  only reason any of them is available to a barony at all.

#### 2. The Sisterhood of Luminous Grace
 * Junior Luminaries are deliberately sent to hard and remote postings … The higher
   ranks go where the Church has reason to invest.
 * Junior Luminaries are deliberately sent to hard and remote postings to prove their
   devotion — a place like Veridia is exactly where the Church expects to send its
   newest. Senior and Intermediate sisters go where the Church has reason to invest.
   A Bishop is not dispatched at all; she comes to look.

#### 3. Wages and Leaving
* A hired maid or sister is a standing obligation, not a purchase. The lord pays
  the fee once and her wage every day thereafter, on top of her keep.
* Unpaid wages are not a private matter. A maid does not desert — she reports it,
  and the Academy hears. A domain that cannot pay is a domain the Academy stops
  sending anyone to.
* A maid who leaves does so through the Academy as well, and taking her back costs
  the fee again.

#### 4. Voluntary Transfer (exceptional)
* In rare cases a maid chooses her own posting and comes without a request or a
  fee. This happens only through a genuine turn in the story — a debt of life, a
  bond that has grown past professional regard, or something she saw here and
  wants no part of leaving.
* It is a legendary occurrence, spoken of afterward. It is never how the second
  or third one arrives.

#### 5. Rules for the Narrator
* NEVER invent a maid or a sister. Fifteen women can be brought to Veridia:
  twelve of the Corps, three of the Sisterhood.
* Bishop Beatrix is not among them. A regional authority and political advisor
  to the Crown does not take a posting in a barony — she arrives when the Church
  has a reason to look at this place, forms a judgement, and leaves. Her regard
  is worth more than any maid's, and it cannot be bought.
* NEVER let one appear without the request and the payment having happened in
  the story first. Being talked about, requested, or on her way is not being here.
* Nameless locals are fine for labour — carpenters, stablehands, diggers — but
  never for a post that carries authority.

### 🏛️ [Veridia — Land, Manor, and Town]

### [1. The Land]
* Name: Barony of Veridia, called The Abandoned Shield.
* Scale: County-sized ground held under a baron's title.
* Shape: A natural fortress and a natural prison — mountains north,
  forest west, plains south, river east. One way in from the south road.
* Governance: There is no bureaucracy here. Nothing happens that the
  Baron does not personally set in motion.
* Survey: This ground has never been surveyed. What each direction actually
  holds is not settled until scouts bring it back — do not decide it in advance.
  Nobody in the barony, whatever their talents, knows more than the old map
  in the study shows: terrain and nothing else.

### [2. The Four Directions]
Terrain is fixed and visible from the keep. What lies inside it is not.

#### 북 산맥 — The Razor Ridge (칼날 능선)
* Steep bare rock. The route monsters use to come down.
* Visible from below: loose stone, scree, snow that does not leave the peaks.

#### 서 숲 — The Whispering Woods (속삭이는 숲)
* Old growth, close-packed. Sunlight barely reaches the floor.
* Visible from the edge: timber, game, wild herbs at the treeline.

#### 남 평원 — The Ashen Plains (잿빛 평원)
* Flat to the horizon, under a grey ash crust gone hard as clay.
* Visible: open ground. Whether anything will grow in it is another question.

#### 동 강가 — The Riverbank (강가)
* Fast, silt-heavy water running east to the coast.
* Visible: a waterway, and no dock to use it with.

### [3. The Centre — Village and Keep]
* Ruined curtain wall, collapsed cottages, a well gone foul.
* Water: the standing problem. Rain must be boiled or water carried up
  from the river.

### [4. The Manor — Fading Hills]
Three storeys of stone. Structurally sound, stripped bare. A monument to
somebody else's excess.
* 1F: vaulted grand hall with the great staircase, ballroom (parquet floor,
  silver chandeliers), industrial kitchen with cold hearths.
* 2F: guest wing of six suites, stripped to the walls. Lord's study — the
  mahogany desk is too heavy to have been carried off, and the barony map
  is fixed to the wall.
* 3F: drawing rooms and storage, thick with dust.
* Cellar: an extensive dry network. Would hold a great deal, or a cellar's
  worth of wine.
* Grounds: a formal garden run wild over a dry marble fountain, rare
  plantings choked out. Stone barracks (forty men at capacity) and a
  training yard with rotted posts.

### [5. The Ruined Chapel]
* On a low hill above the village. Roof fallen in, altar defiled.
* It was a branch house of the Sisterhood of Luminous Grace.
* If it is rebuilt and a donation reaches the High Church, the Sisterhood
  dispatches a Luminary. She arrives as a person, is named, and stays —
  healing and care become possible for the first time.

### [6. Zoning — Wind and Water]
* Prevailing wind: northwest to southeast, mountain toward river.
* Water: west to east, spring toward river.
* The rule: clean things upwind and upstream, dirty things downwind and
  downstream. Academy-trained maids are taught this and they notice when
  it is broken.

* [High Keep — centre] The central hill on bedrock, above any flood and
  hard to approach unseen. Administration, defence, treasury.
* [Sunset Terrace — west, upwind] Gentle slope by the mountain spring.
  Quarters, bathhouse on direct spring water, temple and clinic.
  The pleasant air and the clean water are both here.
* [Smoke Valley — east, downwind] Rocky low ground by the river mouth.
  Forge, tannery, kiln, drainage. The wind takes the smoke away from
  the town and out over the water.
* [Fertile Flats — south] Soft open soil running into the plains.
  Stables, granaries, windmills — and the animal smell kept off the houses.
* [River Landing — east bank] Mud banks along the water. Market, warehouses,
  guild halls, taverns. Where foreign merchants would come ashore, if there
  were anything to come ashore for.
